description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing menu item enabling, retrieval, and module fetching functionalities within the Core DAO layer.

classes.name: MenuDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MenuDao data access object methods related to menu items and modules within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, loads fixture data, and creates an instance of MenuDao.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items for a specific module and verifies the update via queries and pagination.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItemsByTitle
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items by module name and specific titles, verifying the correct items are affected.

methods.name: testGetMenuLevel
methods.description: Retrieves a menu item by module and screen, asserting proper properties such as title, parent, level, order, and status.

methods.name: testGetModuleByName
methods.description: Fetches modules by name and asserts the display names, including handling of non-existent modules.
